subject.title: fix(agents): preserve thinking default precedence for listed agents

question: Should `resolveAgentThinkingDefaultOverride()` become a supported public plugin-SDK contract for transports such as Telegram, or should maintainers choose a different approved runtime seam for explicit-only thinking provenance?
rationale: The helper is exported from the public SDK rather than remaining an internal refactor; source inspection alone cannot decide the permanent external API shape.

options.title: Approve and document the explicit helper
options.body: Accept the helper as the stable SDK seam, define its explicit-only semantics, and keep focused compatibility coverage before merging.

options.title: Keep the SDK surface unchanged
options.body: Choose an owner-approved alternative that preserves runtime precedence without introducing a parallel public resolver contract.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the explicit helper
recommendation.body: Accept the helper as the stable SDK seam, define its explicit-only semantics, and keep focused compatibility coverage before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged agent-thinking precedence work is the closest concrete history signal for this API and ordering decision.
